user.title: Add an air conditioner
user.description: One entry per unit, since each one has its own IR blaster.

data_description.protocol: Match this to the remote your unit came with.
data_description.codec: The code format your IR blaster accepts, or "Home Assistant infrared entity" to hand the frame to an IR blaster Home Assistant drives natively.
data_description.send_delay: How long to wait after the last change before transmitting, so a burst of changes becomes one IR frame instead of several. Leave empty for 0.1 s, raise it if commands still get dropped, or set 0 to send every change on its own.
data_description.power_sensor: Tells the integration when the unit was turned off by something else.

mqtt.name: MQTT
mqtt.description: For blasters that send encoded codes over a MQTT topic.

data_description.mqtt_topic: Where the IR code is published, e.g. zigbee2mqtt/bedroom-blaster/set.
data_description.payload_key: JSON key the code is published under. Leave empty for the output format's default.

infrared.name: Home Assistant infrared
infrared.description: For the "Home Assistant infrared entity" output format, which hands raw timings to an emitter and needs no MQTT topic.

data_description.infrared_entity: Which infrared entity transmits the frame. Empty means this Home Assistant has no infrared entity, so set up an IR blaster first.

error.mqtt_topic_required: This output format publishes over MQTT, so it needs a topic.
error.infrared_entity_required: This output format transmits through an infrared entity, so it needs one.
